box-office.production-tickets.empty.desc: Add dates on the Dates tab, then set each one up for sale.
box-office.setup.unpublished.title: The production is not published
box-office.setup.unpublished.description: Its booking pages open once it is published, so buyers cannot book online yet, even while this performance is on sale.
box-office.setup.run.title: The whole run
box-office.setup.run.description: Set up and sell every performance of this production at once. New dates take the run's set-up when they are scheduled.
box-office.setup.run.copy.one: Copy this set-up to 1 performance not set up yet
box-office.setup.run.copy.other: Copy this set-up to {count} performances not set up yet
box-office.setup.run.all-done: Every performance of this production is set up and on sale.
box-office.setup.run.copy-skipped.one: 1 was left alone: its space holds fewer seats than this set-up.
box-office.setup.run.copy-skipped.other: {count} were left alone: their spaces hold fewer seats than this set-up.
box-office.setup.run.open-skipped.one: 1 is not ready: open it to see what is missing.
box-office.setup.run.open-skipped.other: {count} are not ready: open each to see what is missing.

box-office.production-tickets.run-prices: What each ticket type costs in each section at every performance. Leave one empty not to sell it. To charge one night differently, or to change prices from a later date, use that performance's set-up.
box-office.layouts.description: The ways each space is set out. Each says how many seats it holds and how many wheelchair spaces it has. A show uses its space's usual layout unless another is chosen for a performance.
box-office.layouts.delete.consequence: Performances that have taken place keep what they sold. A layout still used by a performance to come cannot be deleted.
box-office.layouts.empty.title: No seating layouts yet
box-office.layouts.empty.description: Add a layout to count wheelchair spaces. A room set out one way needs only one.
box-office.layouts.empty.no-spaces: Add a venue with a space that holds performances first.
box-office.layouts.keep-back: Seats for wheelchair spaces not yet booked are kept back from ordinary tickets until shortly before the start, then go on general sale.
box-office.layouts.name: Name
box-office.layouts.name-help: Such as End-on or In the round.
box-office.layouts.seats-help: Leave blank for what the space holds.
box-office.layouts.each-label: Seats each space takes the place of
box-office.layouts.each-help: 0 where the spaces are kept apart from the seats. Booking a space takes these seats out of the house.
box-office.layouts.performance.title: Wheelchair spaces
box-office.layouts.performance.descripti: As the run has them, or this performance's own. A layout chosen here for a show sold as one part of the house also sets its seats.
box-office.production-tickets.run-prices: What each ticket type costs at every performance. Leave one empty not to sell it. To charge one night differently, or to change prices from a later date, use that performance's set-up.
box-office.layouts.choice.usual-descript: Set in Seating layouts, beside Venues.
box-office.layouts.run.title: Wheelchair spaces
box-office.layouts.run.description: How many wheelchair spaces every performance has, and the seats each takes the place of. A performance can have its own on its set-up.
box-office.layouts.run.own.one: {count} performance has wheelchair spaces of its own, which this leaves as they are.
box-office.layouts.run.own.other: {count} performances have wheelchair spaces of their own, which this leaves as they are.
box-office.layouts.section-help: The name of a show's section here, such as Stalls. Left blank, or where a show has no section by that name, the seats come from its first section.
box-office.layouts.release.button: Put kept seats on sale now
box-office.layouts.release.consequence: The seats kept for wheelchair spaces not yet booked go on general sale now, before the keep-back time. If they sell, someone who needs a space later may find it cannot be booked.
box-office.navigation.passes.label: Passes
box-office.abilities.pass.manage.label: Set up passes and their prices
box-office.passes.description: A pass is paid for once and gives one entry at each performance it covers. The holder still reserves for each visit, with the pass's code.
box-office.passes.empty.title: No passes yet
box-office.passes.empty.description: Make a pass for a season, a festival or a run of shows. People pay once, then reserve for each visit.
box-office.passes.field.name: Name
box-office.passes.field.description-help: Shown where the pass is sold.
box-office.passes.field.covers-window-he: Optional. Performances outside these dates are not covered.
box-office.passes.field.prices-help: The pass's own prices. They are not tied to ticket types: a pass gives one entry to whatever it covers.
box-office.passes.per-show.once-help: To see a show again, the holder changes their booking or buys a ticket.
box-office.passes.per-show.any-help: The holder can come back to the same show. Never two entries at one performance.
box-office.passes.field.uses-help: Blank for no limit beyond what it covers.
box-office.passes.holder.auto: The holder, when the price is only for some people. Otherwise anyone with the code
box-office.passes.field.reserve-unpaid: Can reserve before it is paid for
box-office.passes.field.reserve-unpaid-h: A pass reserved to pay at the box office can make reservations. What is owed is taken on the holder's first visit.
box-office.passes.field.recheck: Check who qualifies each time it reserves
box-office.passes.field.recheck-help: For a price only some people can buy, such as Members: a lapsed membership stops the pass until it is renewed. Otherwise it is checked only when the pass is bought.
box-office.passes.channel.all: Online and at the box office
box-office.passes.field.sale-help: Blank for as long as it is on sale.
box-office.book.pass.title: Passes
box-office.book.pass.owed: {amount} still to pay for the pass
box-office.book.pass.wheelchair: I will be using a wheelchair space
box-office.book.pass.wheelchair-help: Still one entry on your pass.
box-office.book.pass.another: Someone with you has a pass too?
box-office.book.pass.help: Each pass covers one entry. The code is on the pass and in its email.
box-office.book.pass.repeated: That pass is already added. Each pass gives one entry.
box-office.book.pass-offer.title: {name} · from {from}
box-office.book.pass-offer.shows.one: This show and 1 more for one price.
box-office.book.pass-offer.shows.other: This show and {count} more for one price.
box-office.book.pass-offer.covers: One price for every show it covers.
box-office.book.pass-offer.first: Buy it here and today's ticket is your first.
box-office.book.pass-offer.sign-in: Sign in to buy at this price.
box-office.book.pass-offer.entry: Your ticket for this performance comes with it.
box-office.door.scan.result.pass: This is a pass, which books tickets but does not admit anyone. Ask for their ticket for tonight, or send them to the box office to get one with the pass.
box-office.passes.holders.title: {name} holders
box-office.passes.holders.description: Everyone who holds this pass, what they have booked with it and whether it is paid for.
box-office.passes.holders.is-cancelled: This pass has been cancelled. It cannot book anything more.
box-office.passes.holders.not-paid-help: It is collected with the next booking the pass is used on, online or at the till.
box-office.passes.holders.none-booked: Nothing is booked with this pass yet.
box-office.passes.holders.move-help: What is already booked with the pass stays booked. From now on it is theirs to use.
box-office.passes.holders.sent: The pass's code has been sent to its holder.
box-office.passes.holders.settle-consequ: Use this only when the {amount} was taken some other way. Money taken at the till or online is recorded by itself.
box-office.passes.holders.settled: The pass is marked as paid.
box-office.passes.holders.cancel-consequ: The pass will not book anything more. Tickets already booked with it stay as they are, and any refund is made from the order it was bought on.
box-office.passes.holders.restored: The pass can be used again.
box-office.passes.holders.give-who-help: Leave this empty for a pass anyone with the code may use, where the pass allows that.
box-office.passes.holders.give-settled-h: A gift, or paid for some other way. Otherwise the price is collected with the first booking the pass is used on.
box-office.navigation.my-passes.label: My passes
box-office.my-passes.help: Passes you hold and what you have booked with them.
box-office.my-passes.empty: You do not hold any passes
box-office.my-passes.empty-description: A pass bought with a booking appears here, with the code that books with it.
box-office.my-passes.code-help: Add it when you choose tickets, or give it at the box office. It books your ticket; the ticket is what gets you in.
box-office.my-passes.pay-title: Pay for your pass on your next visit
box-office.my-passes.pay-help: The {amount} is added to the next booking you make with it, to pay online or at the box office.
